manifest.description: Retrieval-driven long-term memory backed by a Mem0 platform account, a self-hosted Mem0 server, or the embedded Mem0 engine running on this device with its own extraction model and embedder.

fields.name: backend
fields.label: Kept At
fields.description: Which Mem0 deployment to talk to: the hosted platform API, a self-hosted server, or the embedded engine on this device (oss).

fields.name: apiKey
fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Mem0 credential: the platform API key, or the server's JWT or m0sk_ API key.

fields.name: baseUrl
fields.label: Server Address
fields.description: Backend origin. Required for the server backend; overrides https://api.mem0.ai for the platform backend. The credential travels to whatever this names, so use https:// for anything off this machine -- http:// sends the conversation and the key in the clear.

fields.name: userId
fields.label: Memory Owner
fields.description: Mem0 user identity memories are stored under.

fields.name: ossLlmModel
fields.label: Remembering Model
fields.description: Embedded engine only: extraction model name; unset uses the engine default (gpt-5-mini). Some models return empty extractions for the engine's prompt even though the API works; test yours, and prefer small instruction-following models.

fields.name: ossLlmApiKey
fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Embedded engine only: API key for the extraction endpoint. Required when ossLlmBaseUrl is unset (the OpenAI cloud); local servers ignore keys.

fields.name: ossLlmBaseUrl
fields.label: Server
fields.description: Embedded engine only: OpenAI-compatible extraction endpoint. Unset means the OpenAI cloud; e.g. http://localhost:1234/v1 for LM Studio or http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama. Use https:// for anything off this machine -- http:// sends the conversation and the key in the clear.

fields.name: ossEmbedderModel
fields.label: Searching Model
fields.description: Embedded engine only: embedding model name; unset uses the engine default (text-embedding-3-small).

fields.name: ossEmbedderApiKey
fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Embedded engine only: API key for the embedding endpoint; unset reuses ossLlmApiKey only while the embedding endpoint matches the extraction endpoint -- a separate endpoint needs its own key.

fields.name: ossEmbedderBaseUrl
fields.label: Server
fields.description: Embedded engine only: OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint; unset reuses ossLlmBaseUrl. Use https:// for anything off this machine -- http:// sends the conversation and the key in the clear.

layout.footer: The key is only needed if your server has one.

layout.title: Remembering
layout.footer: The model that picks what to remember. Name a server like Ollama to keep everything on this computer.

layout.title: Searching
layout.footer: The model that files memories so she can find them. Empty uses the same as Remembering.
